title: Mask Adoption Dynamics
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, policy interventions, information campaigns, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People observe contacts' mask use and opinions; adoption probability updates via social influence along network ties.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations apply mandates and enforcement; non-compliant persons may face denial of entry or penalties, increasing compliance probability.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Media and authorities broadcast messages that shift perceived efficacy, risk, and norms.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Persons buy masks subject to price, availability, and budget, updating inventory.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contextual_use
interactions.description: Persons move through locations (home, work/school, transit, retail) with context-specific mask requirements influencing behavior.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Environment provides a prevalence/risk signal (exogenous or from an optional epidemic module) that updates personal risk perception and adoption.

interactions.name: subsidy_price_effect
interactions.description: Authority subsidies reduce consumer price and/or increase supply, affecting purchase and adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of people wearing masks at each timestep (overall and by context).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days until adoption first exceeds a specified target (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption
metrics.description: Duration that adoption remains above the target without falling below for a grace period.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference-in-differences estimate of adoption attributable to mandates/enforcement/campaigns.

metrics.name: price_sensitivity
metrics.description: Elasticity of adoption with respect to price changes.

metrics.name: supply_constraint_index
metrics.description: Frequency and duration of stockouts that prevent purchase when desired.

metrics.name: inequality_index
metrics.description: Variance or Gini of adoption across groups (e.g., by age group or location).

metrics.name: person_days_masked
metrics.description: Cumulative person-days of mask wearing over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: information_campaign_reach_effect
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to media/communication intensity.

metrics.name: churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which individuals switch between mask use and non-use across timesteps.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_curve_fit
validation_criteria.description: When calibrating to observed data, the RMSE between simulated and target adoption curves should be below a predefined threshold (e.g., RMSE < 0.05).

validation_criteria.name: stability_check
validation_criteria.description: Under fixed inputs, repeated runs (different seeds) yield similar aggregate adoption (e.g., coefficient of variation < 10%).

validation_criteria.name: resource_consistency
validation_criteria.description: Supply stock levels never become negative; unmet demand is tracked as backorders or lost sales.

validation_criteria.name: policy_response_monotonicity
validation_criteria.description: Increasing enforcement or communication intensity weakly increases equilibrium adoption in sensitivity tests.
